title: Nest Protect Low Battery Propagation
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nestprotect:event event=battery
| stats count(eval(battery_pct<20)) as low_battery_devices by home
| where low_battery_devices>0
| sort - low_battery_devices
description: Uses Nest Protect battery telemetry telemetry to monitor how many devices in each home are entering low-battery state in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for smoke or CO monitors that need attention soon, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nest Protect battery telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Home table of low-battery Nest Protect devices.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how many devices in each home are entering low-battery state so you can spot smoke or CO monitors that need attention soon before it becomes annoying.
